title: Patch 20 - Reading Comprehension Integration
description: Adds Reading Comprehension as a full AFOQT subject with passage-based question clusters.
questionRoutingRules: 2. Each JSON contains a single passage and its question cluster.

uiIntegration: Use rc_passage_block to render the passage.

implementationNotes: Ensure grouped questions remain attached to their parent passage.
